Title: Smooth hiring process - Within all SLA targets
Note: Edge case: Exceptionally fast hiring (24 days vs 45 target) - tests lower boundary

Title: Candidate no-show on first interview
Note: Edge case: Single no-show within acceptable 5% rate but causes schedule delay

Title: Screening completion delayed beyond 5-day SLA
RootCause: HR team member on medical leave - high volume backlog
Note: Edge case: 4-day delay (1 day from threshold) - causes downstream delays

Title: Multiple candidate no-shows in first round
RootCause: Candidates had conflicting interviews with other organizations
Note: Edge case: No-show rate 20% exceeds acceptable 5% limit - SLA BREACH

Title: Candidate withdraws after final interview
RootCause: Candidate received better offer from competitor
CorrectiveAction: Approached 2nd choice candidate with expedited offer
Note: Edge case: Candidate dropout at final stage - causes critical SLA impact, need to restart process

Title: Background check delayed - documentation missing
CorrectiveAction: Sent automated document checklist to candidate upfront
Note: Edge case: 3-day delay (within 10-day SLA) but on the boundary of acceptable

Title: Interview scheduled but repeatedly rescheduled
RootCause: Interviewer scheduling conflicts - multiple calendar conflicts
Note: Edge case: Multiple rescheduling (3 times) causes frustration, tests interviewer availability

Title: Position filled exceptionally fast - Quality concern
RootCause: Excellent fit candidate, minimal time spent on evaluation
Note: Edge case: Hiring completed in 7 days (16% of 45-day SLA) - tests lower boundary and quality validation

Title: Offer acceptance negotiation extends timeline
RootCause: Candidate requested salary adjustment and benefits modification
Note: Edge case: 13 days for acceptance vs 10-day target (3 days over) but still resolved

Title: Background check failure - Additional investigation required
RootCause: University transcript showed slight discrepancy in degree completion date
CorrectiveAction: Verified with university registrar - minor clerical error, approved
Note: Edge case: Background check takes 19 days (just under 20-day extended SLA) due to verification complexity

Title: Onboarding delayed - Incomplete training materials
RootCause: Learning management system update delayed training material upload
CorrectiveAction: Used paper-based materials temporarily, migrated to LMS after update
Note: Edge case: Onboarding delayed 5 days but still within 30-day completion window

Title: Hiring timeline exceeded 60 days - Position critically unfilled
RootCause: First candidate withdrew after offer, required complete restart with 2nd candidate, multiple background check delays
CorrectiveAction: Expedited onboarding, added signing bonus, expanded recruitment team
Note: Edge case: 65 days (44% over target 45 days, 5 days over critical 60-day threshold) - CRITICAL BREACH

Title: Month-end hiring deadline pressure with multiple candidates
RootCause: Month-end deadline pressure led to simultaneous multiple offers, competing organizations made counter-offers
CorrectiveAction: Staggered offers next month, offered signing bonus to first acceptor
Note: Edge case: Simultaneous offers with competing deadline pressure, only 1/3 acceptance (33% vs 70% target)

Title: Candidate communication delays - Poor response rate
RootCause: Candidate was working and responded outside business hours
Note: Edge case: Exactly 48-hour response time (at boundary) but process continues smoothly

Title: Perfect hiring cycle - All metrics exceed targets
Note: Edge case: 15 days to hire (33% of target) - exceptional efficiency with all metrics exceeding targets
